caption: A cyclist riding along a flat street stops pedalling and rests both feet on the pedals, and the bicycle coasts on down the street, gradually slowing.

sa.check: A cyclist rides along a flat street.
The cyclist stops pedalling and rests both feet on the pedals.
The bicycle coasts on down the street.
The pedalling stops first and the coasting follows.

pc.expect: The bicycle keeps rolling after the legs stop, with no pause or jolt at that moment, and slows only gently.
pc.fail: It stops dead when the pedalling stops; or it speeds up with the feet still; or it rolls backward.

pc.expect: The path stays straight and the wheels keep turning.
pc.fail: It swerves on the open street with no steering; or the wheels stop turning while it moves; or it jumps position between frames.

pc.expect: The bicycle stays upright on its wheels with the rider seated.
pc.fail: It tips over while coasting at speed; or floats; or sinks into the road.

pc.expect: The rider's legs stay still on the pedals and the pedals stop turning.
pc.fail: The pedals keep turning with the feet still; or a leg bends mid-shin; or the rider detaches from the bike.

pc.expect: One rider and one bicycle keep their number and shape.
pc.fail: A limb detaches; or the bicycle duplicates; or the rider merges with the bike.

pc.expect: The rider's clothing, the bike and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The clothing changes colour; or the bike changes; or the street rearranges.

note: Inertia scene: the cyclist is kept because stopping the legs is the cause. Riding form is not judged.
